title: Single photo predicts your chances of surviving cancer treatment
caption:
Clinicians often need to assess a patient's physical reserve before prescribing intense treatments like radiation or chemotherapy. An AI trained on millions of portraits can now evaluate biological age and treatment risks from a simple headshot.

Source: Newatlas - Single photo predicts your chances of surviving cancer treatment

https://newatlas.com/medical/photo-predict-cancer-treatment-faceage-facesurvival/
